changes.title: Add private experimental visual speeds
changes.text: Add test-build-only 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x, 64x, 100x and 1000x visual playback with a scrollable picker. Preserve the normal 0.5x, 1x and 2x options in public builds, ignore private-only saved values outside test builds, and keep actor turns, HUD timing, RNG and global clock unchanged.

changes.title: Verify extreme-speed isolation and existing history
changes.text: Retain all full core public/private speed, persistence and clock regressions, extended existing Android real-touch speed-picker acceptance, core-only proof, and reviewed source and history records since the previous compiled APK.

commentary: Complete core-only run 39061905957 succeeded after 3 new PlaybackSpeedTest methods. Require full candidate: 1779 core, 38 API-34, debug APK, complete compiled TEST269 history and 57 reviewed screenshots. No release or tester distribution without separate approval.
